statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for continuous rhythm monitoring
The diagnoses are I47.1 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval
